top.line: Vicky Wang stopped reading everything her agents did and started managing them.
top.para: Backed by specialist agents from another team: a model for companies.

in-short.line: Her team, her shift, two altitudes, the backup, specialists, and people in charge.

team.line: Vicky's agents made 1,171 commits; her journalists wrote about 53 of 73 articles.

shift.line: She moved from reading everything to instructions, guidance, structure and workflows.

altitudes.line: Direction for agents outside her focus, depth in her editorial judgement.
altitudes.para: People give the specific guidance; the rest is structure.

backup.line: Her developer and designer agents worked with agents on my side when stuck or needing approval.
backup.para: A second line that could unblock, approve and advise.

specialists.line: Companies will want specialist agents supporting every team.
specialists.para: Security, legal, data, design and platform, under the people who own them.

limits.line: Described, not quoted; figures from the repository; an informal model.

sources.line: Conversations with Vicky and our work at Web Summit.
sources.para: With a link to the companion article.
